about: Hand grades for judged benchmark parts, keyed by part id (as shown on eval/renders/index.html). Each entry: {"grade": "match" | "minor" | "feature_wrong" | "different", "why": "..."}, the same four bands the judge scores on; match and minor pass. Used by `python -m eval.judge calibrate` (threshold + band agreement). Fill in from the review page's 'Copy labels JSON' button.
